initial37_failure.reason: New interval function accepted list/tuple but sorted mixed containers without a common tuple representation. Native process had ended before repair. New candidate-only correction; raw first failed logs retained unchanged.

first_snapshot_native0_superseded: Contained plural scalar seeds=count ambiguities. Retained and SHA-bound; final39 rejects/gaps these values and final snapshot replaces only candidate inference, not prior facts or scientific data.
read_only_extraction_limitations: Initial scope/shape discovery used absolute rg patterns that did not reliably exclude every .git/venv subtree; not used as authoritative coverage proof. Fixed scanner uses explicit os.walk directory pruning/reparse refusal and raw files.

Initial JSON seed-field discovery shell finished0 but its90337-token stdout was truncated; not claimed complete nor used as raw audit proof. Later fixed scanner launch captured full native snapshot JSON directly to fresh stdout files.

One initial Get-Content used incorrect root-level a96_seed_registry.json path and produced a nonterminating read error while wrapper exit0; correct normative docs/rebuild/a96_seed_registry.json was read using the v14 source path. No file edit/scientific FAIL inferred.
